sentence_stem: Not only did the reviewers reject the proposal,
correct_completion: but they also demanded a complete redesign of the study.
full_sentence: Not only did the reviewers reject the proposal, but they also demanded a complete redesign of the study.
acceptable_variants: but they also questioned the authors' conclusions.
but they also rejected the research methods.

options.text: so the study was approved without changes.
options.why_wrong: 'Not only' sets up an addition that intensifies the first clause, not an approval that contradicts it.

options.text: because the budget had already been spent.
options.why_wrong: This gives a cause, but the stem expects a further, intensifying point introduced by 'but also'.

options.text: but they also demanded a complete redesign of the study.
and the reviewers later apologised for the delay.
options.why_wrong: This describes an unrelated later event. 'Not only' requires a further criticism or demand of the same kind.

grammar_focus: Inversion after 'Not only' (auxiliary 'did' before the subject)
explanation: After 'Not only', the auxiliary 'did' comes before the subject, and the sentence must continue with 'but also' to add a stronger point. Turkish speakers often attach the second clause with a simple coordinating word, but English expects 'but also' to balance the structure.
translation: Hakemler teklifi reddetmekle kalmadı, çalışmanın tamamının yeniden tasarlanmasını da talep etti.
